# Design System: [Project]

> Base: [Angular Material 22 | Taiga UI 5 | PrimeVue | custom] · Date:

## 1. Principles
3–5 principles (clarity, density, tone).

## 2. Tokens (`--ds-*`)
- Colour: roles (surface, on-surface, primary, on-primary, error, outline…) for light/dark; contrast verified.
- Spacing: scale (4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64).
- Typography: families, scale (display/headline/title/body/label), fluid sizes.
- Radii, shadows/elevation, motion (durations, easing), z-index layers.
Mapping onto the base library's tokens (`--mat-*` / `--tui-*` / `@theme`).

## 3. Components
Inventory: name → purpose → variants → states (default/hover/focus/active/disabled/error/loading) → aria pattern → base library component.

## 4. Patterns
Forms and validation, tables/lists, empty states, notifications/toasts, dialogs, navigation, loading.

## 5. Themes
Light/dark (`color-scheme`, `light-dark()`), high contrast, user scaling.

## 6. Icons and illustrations
Set, sizes, licences.

## 7. Game UI (if any)
HUD layers, numeric fonts, safe areas, scaling, colour-blind palettes.
